title: When speech keeps outrunning wisdom under pressure
issueStatement: Words arrive before the heart has been cleaned enough to carry them well. Pressure exposes what the mind reaches for when it feels cornered.
centralInsight: Guru makes speech answer to praise, restraint, and truthfulness. Pressure becomes revealing when the line is allowed to interrupt panic and performance.
practicalReflection: Guard the tongue, and the heart begins to clear. Refuse one unnecessary sharp word before it leaves the mouth.
actionPrompt: Refuse one unnecessary sharp word before it leaves the mouth. Use the line before the pressure decides the tone.
